llm.summary: This appears to be a real image-prompt toolkit, but it needs Review because some integrations can send local files, prompts, images, and API keys to network services with weak scoping.

dimensions.detail: Provider API keys and network calls are purpose-aligned for rendering and review, but ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is accepted without host or scheme validation, local service URLs are environment-controlled, and diagnostics reveal API-key prefixes.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No automatic installer or config writer was observed, but the documentation instructs users to register an MCP server in ~/.claude/mcp.json and optionally run a local Web UI, which expands the trusted tool surface.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill uses very broad aliases and documents automatic agent triggering on generic creative terms such as 文生图, 文生视频, 提示词增强, and 赛博朋克, which is too broad for tooling that can call external APIs, read files, and persist data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistent characters, sessions, brand kits, learned presets, and Obsidian writes are disclosed and mostly user-directed, but the Web UI exposes character data through an unauthenticated local API with wildcard CORS.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented purpose and most capabilities fit an image prompt, rendering, review, storyboard, and style-learning toolkit; the main mismatch is that image review accepts any local path or URL and uploads the bytes as image data, including through the MCP tool surface.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a creative toolkit that can call paid external model APIs, persist project data under ~/.huo15, and expose MCP tools to your agent. Avoid registering the MCP server in untrusted or shared agent environments, do not use review_image on arbitrary paths, keep ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL unset unless it points to a trusted HTTPS gateway, and run the Web UI only on loopback with non-sensitive character data.
llm.findings:
[T05] unexpected: Confirmed: mcp_server.py exposes review_image, and image_review.py opens arbitrary local paths or URLs, base64-encodes the bytes, and posts them to the Claude endpoint without path containment or image validation.
[T09] unexpected: Partly confirmed: API-backed features are expected, but forwarding ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to an unvalidated ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and printing credential prefixes in doctor.py are not needed for the stated purpose.
[TT3] unexpected: Network calls to Anthropic and image providers are expected for this toolkit, but the unvalidated base URL, arbitrary URL fetches, and default live doctor ping create real trust-boundary concerns.
[AS2] expected: MCP registration is clearly part of the IDE integration and appears manual rather than automatic, but it is still high-trust setup that users should perform only after reviewing the server script.
[TP4] expected: Downgraded in part: SKILL.md and QUICKSTART.md disclose rendering, API keys, output files, local persistence, MCP, and Web UI behavior; the remaining concern is weak scoping rather than hidden functionality.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Confirmed: aliases and trigger language are broad enough to cause accidental skill activation in ordinary image or design conversations.
[AE1] expected: Overridden: scripts/web_ui.py is present in the artifact and was inspected; the file itself raises CORS and authentication concerns, not analysis-evasion concerns.
[EA5] expected: Model and provider choices are documented command-line options for a multi-provider creative toolkit; this is expected, though users should understand cost and data-sharing implications before use.
